page: Amazon Web Services g5.24xlarge is an accelerated computing instance based on the AWS Nitro system. The server features an AMD EPYC 7R32 processor providing 96 dedicated vCPUs across 48 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The CPU cache architecture comprises 32 KB L1 data, 0.5 MB L2, and 16 MB L3 cache. Memory is provisioned at 384.0 GB of DDR4 operating at 3 GHz, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is delivered via four NVIDIA A10G Ampere GPUs totaling 89 GB of VRAM. The instance includes 3,800 GB of local NVMe SSD storage alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Benchmark results highlight exceptional machine learning inference capabilities driven by the quad NVIDIA A10G accelerators. Large language model evaluation shows top-tier prompt processing speeds ranging from 9,212.26 tokens per second on a small 135M model to 397.89 tokens per second on a 70B parameter model. LLM text generation is consistently strong across scales, reaching 88.36 tokens per second on a 7B model and 10.7 tokens per second on a 70B model. In general compute tasks, the instance delivers strong multi-core throughput, reflected by a PassMark CPU score of 68,546.98, top-tier cryptographic performance at 101,561.54, and high software compilation speeds. Single-core performance is lower, with stress-ng single-core execution placing in the bottom decile and Geekbench single-core scoring 1,310.0.

The dense combination of 4 dedicated GPUs, high-speed NVMe storage, and 50 Gbps networking offers high hardware density suitable for high-throughput distributed architectures. It delivers strong qualitative cost efficiency for multi-GPU training and inference pipelines where localized storage prevents network-bound data stalls. This configuration is well-suited for AI model serving, real-time computer vision, graphics rendering, ray tracing, and high-performance database workloads such as Redis, which reached 79.8 million operations per second.
description: Amazon Web Services g5.24xlarge is an accelerated computing instance powered by a 96-vCPU AMD EPYC 7R32 processor running at 3.3 GHz and 384 GB of DDR4 memory. Designed for heavy graphics and deep learning workloads, the system incorporates four NVIDIA A10G Ampere GPUs with 89 GB of aggregate VRAM, alongside 3,800 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage and 50 Gbps baseline networking. Benchmark evaluations indicate top-tier prompt processing and text generation performance across multiple large language model sizes, as well as strong cryptographic and multi-threaded compilation capabilities. While single-thread CPU performance is comparatively modest, the system demonstrates high multi-core throughput and strong memory caching. This hardware profile suits distributed machine learning inference, real-time rendering, spatial computing, and high-concurrency database deployments.
